name: AppFlowy-Web
description: Step 6/7: AppFlowy Web — the browser-based AppFlowy client. Served at the root path / via the nginx proxy. Part of the AppFlowy Cloud stack.

variables.name: Base URL
variables.description: Public-facing base URL. Must match Base URL in AppFlowy-Cloud. No trailing slash.

variables.name: GoTrue Base URL
variables.description: Public-facing GoTrue URL (used by the browser to reach the auth service).

variables.name: WebSocket Base URL
variables.description: WebSocket URL for real-time collaboration. Change ws:// to wss:// if using TLS.
